audit_scope: Regenerated inputs/labels/identities; inventory, configurations, seeds, baseline replay, fusion/PCA projection and selected GMM dense likelihood, BIC/membership; independent contingency ARI, pseudoinverse axis recovery and truth-initialization/dense likelihood. No model refits. Nonselected GMM likelihoods inferred from preserved BIC logs, not independently recomputed; view PCA eigen-equations and raw moments independently checked without refitting; convergence histories preserved, not independently refitted.
interpretation: Exploratory recovery diagnostics under one constructed law, not species validation; no across-score-space absolute BIC comparisons or automatic configuration selection. First-specimen control removes replication and unequal source weighting together, not a pure weighting intervention. Wilson intervals are pointwise descriptive, unadjusted for the diagnostic grid.
